name: order_favorites
description: Saved prescriptions and lab orders that staff add to a note in one action. A button in each open visit or chart review note opens a panel of practice and personal favorites; an app in the app drawer lets everyone manage their own favorites, and lets favorites admins manage practice favorites, import, and settings.

protocols.description: Note-header button on open visit and chart review notes that opens the favorites panel for that note.
Serves the favorites panel and admin app, and the API that saves favorites and adds them to notes.

handlers.description: App drawer icon for everyone's own favorites; favorites admins also manage practice favorites, import, and settings there.
